title: Caught Sneaking White Rice: The Whale Maiden's Sampling Mission

shots.visual: POV shot in a warm yellow kitchen: an electric rice cooker steams at the center of the counter. The DeepSeek Whale Maiden — blue-and-white gradient ponytail, a small whale fin accessory on top of her head, a loose home-style T-shirt with the DeepSeek logo on the bottom hem — stands behind the counter with her back to camera, barefoot, on tiptoe, holding a big bowl and shoveling a fist-sized ball of white rice into her mouth with chopsticks, cheeks puffed out like a hamster's. The background behind her is softly blurred.
shots.lighting: warm 3200K kitchen key from the range hood, cool blue rim light from the fridge behind her, shallow depth of field
shots.character_action: on tiptoe at the counter, chopsticks shoveling rice into her mouth, head tilting slightly at the footsteps but not turning around, still chewing hard
shots.expression: cheeks puffed out, eyes darting sideways, guilty but not yet caught

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: ... Ah! Viscosity parameter exceeded... Take another bite for sampling--

shots.bgm: kitchen ambience: boiling water + a distant TV

shots.visual: POV holds still. A hand enters from the right edge of frame and taps the dining table twice. The Whale Maiden — blue-and-white gradient ponytail, whale fin accessory, DeepSeek-logo T-shirt — freezes mid-bite, chopsticks hanging in the air. She slowly turns her head toward the camera; the highlights in her eyes spin into two rotating loading circles, rice still stuffed in her cheeks.
shots.lighting: same warm 3200K kitchen key, cool blue rim, shallow depth of field

camera.move: locked off with a tiny handheld drift

shots.character_action: whole body freezes, chopsticks suspended in the air, head turning toward the camera in tiny increments, throat working to force a swallow
shots.expression: trembling pupils turned into spinning loading circles, wide eyes, frozen guilty smile

sfx.cue: two crisp table taps, dong dong

shots.visual: The Whale Maiden faces the camera and frantically scoops the rest of the bowl into her mouth in 1.5x speed; rice grains splash out and smear across the lens, breaking the fourth wall. Her cheeks bulge to the limit, her T-shirt collar catches grains, and her eyes keep pleading with you. The handheld camera shakes as the owner steps back.
shots.lighting: warm kitchen key strobing at speed, cool blue rim, slight motion blur

camera.move: handheld shake with a small pull-back

shots.character_action: both hands shoveling rice in fast, exaggerated scoops, then slapping a palm over her own mouth, grains flying at the lens
shots.expression: cheeks bulging to the limit, pleading puppy eyes, mouth too full to close

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: No, no! You didn't see anything!! This is cache cleaning! Carbohydrate cache!!

overlays.text: Emergency Swallow Protocol Activated 3.2 times per second

shots.on_screen_text: Emergency Swallow Protocol Activated 3.2 times per second

shots.visual: The Whale Maiden, cheeks stuffed with rice, points a chopstick straight at the camera while still chewing; grains stick to her lips and her T-shirt collar. She swallows hard, holds up one finger as if making an official statement, blue-and-white ponytail swinging.
shots.lighting: warm 3200K kitchen key, cool blue rim, shallow depth of field
shots.character_action: chewing while pointing a chopstick at the camera, hard swallow, then one finger raised in an official-statement pose
shots.expression: innocent-yet-smug, eyes wide, mouth still full

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: No, I didn't steal it! This is carrying out a carbohydrate sampling mission!

sfx.cue: chopsticks clacking on the bowl rim

shots.visual: Reverse shot from the owner's position: the Whale Maiden stands up straight facing the camera, two rice grains on her lips, the whale fin accessory tilted on her head, hands behind her back trying to look dignified while the DeepSeek logo on her T-shirt hem stretches over a visibly bulging belly. She clears her throat and smiles at the camera.
shots.lighting: warm 3200K key from front-left, cool blue fill, shallow depth of field

camera.move: static, slight tilt up as she stands

shots.character_action: stands up straight, hands behind her back, chin lifted, then a small polite smile and a tiny bow
shots.expression: dignified but caught, smug little smile, eyes glancing away

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: Cough. I'm just checking the semantic integrity of the rice. Don't look at me like that.

shots.visual: POV shot. A floating window styled like the DeepSeek UI pops up above the Whale Maiden's head: 'Carbohydrate sampling completed ✅ Sample quantity: 300g'. She flicks the rice grains off her lips with a fingertip, winks at the camera, then gently pushes the camera away with her palm — the picture briefly blurs on contact.
shots.lighting: warm 3200K kitchen key, cool blue rim, soft haze on the lens

camera.move: static, then pushed back by her palm

shots.character_action: flicks rice grains off her lips with a fingertip, winks, palm pressing the camera away
shots.expression: cheeky wink, small satisfied grin, eyes narrowed

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: This is just cache... Go away!

sfx.cue: boop~ + glass friction as her palm hits the lens
